name: Iraq
famous_for: Ancient Mesopotamia ('Cradle of Civilization'), Babylon ruins, Ziggurat of Ur, Tigris and Euphrates rivers, and Mesopotamian Marshes.
tourists: Approx. 1.2M visitors (mostly pilgrims and heritage explorers); highlights include Citadel of Erbil and Holy Shrines of Karbala.
must_know: Mesopotamia is where humans first developed the wheel, written script (cuneiform), legal codes (Hammurabi), and mathematics.
fun_fact: The Citadel of Erbil is considered one of the oldest continuously inhabited human settlements on Earth, dating back 6,000 years.
